verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph exposes a broad set of OneDrive operations via API — file CRUD, upload sessions, sharing links, search, thumbnails, versioning, delta/change tracking — covering most core file-management actions available in the UI (onedrive-docs-5,12,13,14,15,18,21,23). However, several UI-only experiences (real-time coauthoring in Office apps, Files On-Demand explorer integration, 'always keep on this device' offline toggles) are OS/client-level features with no documented API equivalent, so parity is not complete. missing for 10: API-level equivalents for coauthoring UX, Files On-Demand/offline toggles, and any explicit vendor statement of full UI/API parity or independent verification of same.
